Name: Compress
Description: Repack using the compressed (LZMA) BSP format. Without this, repacking an already compressed BSP will decompress it instead.
Warning: Some tools and older engine branches cannot read compressed BSPs

Name: Threads
Description: Number of threads used for LZMA compression. Substantially faster on large maps.

Name: Verbose
Description: Prints detailed information about each file as it is repacked.
